documents.unit: Faculty of Arts and Sciences, Office of Undergraduate Education (Harvard College)
documents.title: Generative AI Guidance
documents.quality_note: Requires faculty to state a course AI policy; sample policies from restrictive to encouraging; FAQ. Covers Harvard College, including CS concentrators.

documents.title: Teach with Generative AI
documents.quality_note: Faculty-facing resource page with some guidance on assessment and academic integrity; much of it is overview and tool lists.

documents.unit: John A. Paulson School of Engineering and Applied Sciences, Computing in Engineering Education
documents.title: Generative AI
documents.quality_note: Short service page: CEE supports faculty integrating generative AI into computational courses and links to integrity standards. Sets few rules.

notes: University-wide interim guidelines (provost.harvard.edu/guidelines-generative-ai, huit.harvard.edu/ai/guidelines, fas.harvard.edu/gai) returned Access Denied to curl, so they are inaccessible as primary text; the FAS OUE page and harvard.edu/ai page were used instead. No SEAS or CS-department-level student policy found; known CS 61 and CS50 URLs are course syllabi (deferred).
